edits.old_string: On the ruling it lands at once on its own branch, its diff operator-approved, through `crucible:finishing-a-development-branch`.
edits.new_string: The ruling also decides whether it takes a campaign (umbrellas.md § Review); it lands on its own branch at once, or when that campaign closes, its diff operator-approved, through `crucible:finishing-a-development-branch`.

note: Binding-change paragraph: the operator's ruling now also decides whether the change takes a campaign (umbrellas.md § Review), and landing waits for that campaign to close where one is taken.
